sites.name: IM-1 Odysseus landing site (near Malapert A)
sites.source_note: NASA LRO release: landed at 80.13 degrees south latitude, 1.44 degrees east longitude. Retrieved 2026-11-14. North of the -80.7 deg terrain limit, so geometric horizon only.

sites.name: IM-2 Athena landing site (Mons Mouton region)
sites.source_note: LROC 'IM-2 Athena Seen Obliquely': lander rests in a 20 m crater at 84.7906 S, 29.1957 E. Retrieved 2026-11-14.

sites.name: IM-2 intended landing site (Mons Mouton region)
sites.source_note: LROC 'IM-2 Landing Region': intended landing site (-84.78, 29.13 E), planned target, not the actual landing point. Retrieved 2026-11-14.
